modules.description: List of netfilter modules (e.g., ip, tcp, udp, icmp) to load before rule processing.

default_input_policy.description: Default policy for the INPUT chain (e.g., ACCEPT, DROP, REJECT).

default_output_policy.description: Default policy for the OUTPUT chain.

default_forward_policy.description: Default policy for the FORWARD chain.

table.description: Netfilter table name (e.g., filter, nat, mangle).

chain.description: Chain name (e.g., INPUT, OUTPUT, FORWARD, or custom like 'ssh_chain').

rules.description: List of raw ferm rules (strings) for this chain.

comment.description: Optional comment explaining this service rule.

name.description: Predefined service name (ssh, http, https, icmp, custom).

port.description: TCP/UDP port number (used for ssh/http/https services).

rules.description: Raw ferm rule(s) for custom services (only used if name='custom').

drop_invalid.description: Whether to explicitly drop invalid packets (enables stateful inspection).

final_policy_input.description: Final policy for INPUT chain (overrides default_input_policy if set).

final_policy_output.description: Final policy for OUTPUT chain (overrides default_output_policy if set).

final_policy_forward.description: Final policy for FORWARD chain (overrides default_forward_policy if set).
